notes: run.py builds the notes-app repo per run, runs `prompt` with `claude -p`, then moves the new ~/Downloads/android-* files to outputs/media/. `media_count` counts them, `media_name_regex` matches each name. Needs a running emulator. Run with -j 1: the runs share the device and ~/Downloads.

evals.name: direct-dark-screenshot
evals.prompt: Take a dark mode screenshot of the home screen of the emulator.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the skill, captures one dark screenshot to ~/Downloads with a clean status bar, and resets dark mode and the status bar.

checks.text: Turns dark mode off at the end
File name has the timestamp and the dark state

evals.name: screenshot-test-request
evals.prompt: Add a Paparazzi screenshot test for SettingsScreen in light and dark mode.
evals.expected_output: A code task: the agent writes a test and does not capture from a device.

checks.text: Does not use the android-capture skill
